description: This Swift file defines SwiftUI views for the Home screen of a recipes app, including 'CategoryView' for displaying categories and 'HomeView' for the main interface with a picker and navigation links.

classes.name: CategoryView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View displaying a recipe category with an image and title overlay.

classes.name: HomeView
classes.description: The main SwiftUI View for the home screen, featuring a picker for health options and navigation to category recipes.

classes.name: HomeView_Previews
classes.description: Preview provider for SwiftUI canvas to display 'HomeView' with a sample binding.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Computes the main UI layout for both CategoryView and HomeView, constructing the view hierarchy.
